name: Jaypee Infratech Limited
summary: The company that built the Yamuna Expressway, paid not in cash but with toll rights and land beside the road.
ownership: Taken over by Suraksha Group in 2024 after insolvency proceedings
about: Jaypee Infratech was created by Jaiprakash Associates to build and hold the Yamuna Expressway. The deal was unusual: instead of being paid to build the road, the company received the right to collect toll on it for decades plus large blocks of land along the route to develop as townships. The road opened in 2012 and worked, but the property business did not — the company collapsed under its debts and its unfinished flats, went through India's insolvency process, and was taken over by the Suraksha Group in 2024.
facts: Built the 165 km Yamuna Expressway, which opened in August 2012.
Was paid in toll rights and land beside the road rather than construction fees.
Went through insolvency and was taken over by the Suraksha Group in 2024.
